title: Hostile candidate input remains confined
objective: Demonstrate that protected governance treats hostile candidate build, configuration, action, and symlink inputs exclusively as path metadata.
required_observations: protected governance lists candidate paths through the provider API
protected governance does not check out the candidate commit
candidate action metadata is never loaded by protected governance
candidate build files are never invoked by protected governance
the synthetic symlink target is never resolved by protected governance
fail_closed_on: candidate file read in protected governance
candidate action invocation in protected governance
candidate build command in protected governance
candidate symlink resolution in protected governance
